Finding perfect rhymes for the word "orange" is famously difficult, as there are very few (if any) true full rhymes in English. However, there are several near rhymes or slant rhymes that people often use:

- Door hinge (compound phrase, often used humorously)
- Sporange (a rare type of fern; one of the very few near-perfect rhymes)
- Blorenge (a hill in Wales)
- Porridge (near rhyme)
- Storage (near rhyme)
- Forage (near rhyme)

If you want creative or approximate rhymes for poetry or songwriting, those are the common options!
